audit.source: Alpaca daily bars (stock, SPY, sector and bond ETFs)
audit.detail: The query ends at the last session before the replayed day, and a series stamped at or after the decision time is dropped. Bars are split- and dividend-adjusted with today's factors, so price levels can differ from what was shown then; returns and indicators do not.

audit.source: Alpaca news (articles and the screen's counts)
audit.detail: Every query ends at the decision time, and an article published at or after it is dropped.
Ends on the replayed day; an article published at or after the decision time is dropped.
Finnhub serves only today's snapshot, so it is not read; the Fundamentals brief records a gap and relies on SEC figures.
Finnhub dates a quarter by its end, not by when it was reported, so a quarter is kept only when an Item 2.02 earnings release filed after it ended and before the replayed day covers it.
The decision's own month is left out, since its counts kept changing after the decision; earlier months are kept.

audit.source: Finnhub earnings calendar (next release, and the screen's earnings flag)
audit.detail: A release on or after the replayed day keeps its date and estimates but loses its actual EPS and revenue. The date shown is the one the calendar holds today, which can differ from the schedule known then.

audit.source: SEC submissions (8-K events, earnings release, Form 4)
audit.detail: Only filings dated before the replayed day are listed, so every event, release, and insider trade read from them was public.
A fact filed on or after the replayed day is left out, so neither a new quarter nor a later restatement leaks in.
Only filing windows that closed before the replayed day are used. SEC's listing does not give when each archive was posted, which the brief already notes as a gap.
The members on the replayed day are rebuilt from today's list by undoing every later change in the historical-components table.
Alpaca lists only today's assets, so every member counts as tradable rather than drop one delisted since.

audit.source: Macro and regime inputs (SPY, sector and bond ETFs)
audit.detail: Computed from the bounded daily bars.
The exchange schedule is published in advance, so the sessions around the day were known then.
